2609.30123.title: HEXIS: Compiling Skills into Extended Finite State Machines
2609.30123.paper_summary: Agent skills provide reusable knowledge and instructions, yet agents must repeatedly infer how to apply them and which operation should follow. This couples task reasoning with control decisions, allowing prescribed steps to be omitted or applied incorrectly. We introduce HEXIS, which compiles agent skills into extended finite state machines that separate knowledge from control flow. Skill knowledge is incorporated into local instructions that guide reasoning and generation within states. The machine records execution progress and intermediate results, while explicit transition conditions determine subsequent operations. Our incremental compiler first maps skill clauses and tool interfaces to state operations, local instructions, data bindings, and transitions. It then aligns development traces with existing states to identify missing operations and dependencies. These are incorporated by adding or reusing states and refining their connections. Updates are accepted only after static checks and replay of the current and all previously accepted traces. Across four benchmarks and four executors, HEXIS improves success over Skill + ReAct by 16.1 percentage points on average. Qwen3.8-27B reduces execution tokens by 38.4-88.9% across benchmarks.
2609.30123.paper_summary_zh: 代理技能提供可重用的知識和指示，但代理必須反覆推斷如何應用它們以及應該跟隨哪個操作。這將任務推理與控制決策結合在一起，允許省略或錯誤應用規定的步驟。我們介紹了 HEXIS，這是一種將代理技能編譯成擴展有限狀態機的系統，將知識與控制流程分開。技能知識被納入本地指令中，以指導狀態內的推理和生成。該機器記錄執行進度和中間結果，而明確的轉換條件決定後續操作。我們的增量編譯器首先將技能條款和工具介面映射到狀態操作、本地指令、數據綁定和轉換。然後，它將開發跟蹤與現有狀態對齊，以識別缺失的操作和依賴關係。這些通過添加或重用狀態並細化其連接來納入。只有在靜態檢查和重播當前及所有先前接受的跟蹤後，更新才會被接受。在四個基準測試和四個執行器中，HEXIS 在成功率上平均提高了 16.1 個百分點，相較於 Skill + ReAct。Qwen3.8-27B 在基準測試中減少了 38.4-88.9% 的執行標記。
2609.30123.author: Minghao LI et.al.
